mapper.sql: id, user_id, usage_date, message_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stt_seconds, tts_chars
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_usage (user_id, usage_date, message_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE message_count = message_count + 1

INSERT INTO daily_usage (user_id, usage_date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE prompt_tokens = prompt_tokens + VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = completion_tokens + VALUES(completion_tokens)
